topic.title: Pretrained models whose training data includes CC BY-NC sources (e.g., HMDB)
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content: Hi organizers, a quick question on external models. Some public de novo generators (for example DiffMS, MIT weights on Zenodo 15122968, and DualLGD, CC BY 4.0 weights on Zenodo 20281201) were pretrained on structure lists that include HMDB, which is licensed CC BY-NC 4.0. The code is MIT and the weights are free and public. Is using such pretrained weights allowed under the external data and model rules? Thank you!

comments.content: If you use that model, will it make your solution also Non-Commercial? If yes then I suspect that you can't use it.

replies.content: As announced in 750330, we have removed the restriction on noncommercial license open source data.

comments.content: Yes, these weights are allowed. (In 750330, the rules on external data were clarified and HMDB is allowed.). Just please make sure that, for any weights used, the original training code and access to permitted training data are available for your final solution.
